purpose: Bind the completed source-only 29-page C-clef development measurement without retuning the measured adapter.

c1Localization.interpretation: No accepted detector box reached IoU 0.50 with any C1 teacher box. The stored result alone cannot distinguish an upstream EOMER mask miss from an adapter rejection; raw rejected-box/mask evidence was not persisted.

rootCauseDiagnostics.adapterArchitectureObservation: The measured adapter assigns subtype from the geometric center of an accepted connected component relative to the nearest staff line. This is only a proxy for the C-clef middle-C pointer and is not a direct pointer localization method.
rootCauseDiagnostics.overgenerationObservation: The adapter accepted 226 detections for 71 teacher boxes. C3 and C4 recall is materially higher than precision, showing that candidate admission is the dominant failure mode after localization.

decision.reason: C1 recall is 0/20 and pooled precision is 0.19469026548672566 with 182 false positives. The current geometric-center/staff-anchor adapter is not safe as a semantic-preservation detector.

nextSafeBoundary.action: Start a separately versioned C-clef detector design; do not retune p4_3 after observing its metrics.
requirements: Persist raw EOMER clefs_keys masks or raw connected-component candidates before adapter rejection so C1 failure can be localized exactly.
Replace bounding-box-center subtype anchoring with direct middle-C pointer or C-clef-shape localization.
Add staff-context candidate control to prevent multiple unrelated symbols from being accepted as clefs.
Freeze the new adapter before evaluation and use an independent held-out C-clef set for qualification.
